name: Artibot
description:
Artibot은 Claude Code를 위한 자율 에이전트 OS입니다. 듀얼 프로세스(System 1/2) 인지 라우팅, 평생 학습(GRPO+RLVR), 28개 전문가 에이전트의 병렬 팀 협업, 100여 개의 스킬과 56개 슬래시
커맨드를 통해 코드 엔지니어링·마케팅·디자인 워크플로우를 자동으로 오케스트레이션합니다. Hook 기반 안전망, 자동 메모리 관리, MCP 통합, OTEL 옵저버빌리티, Git 자동 동기화, 5,000개
이상의 테스트로 프로덕션 등급의 안정성을 제공합니다.
longDescription:
Ships **113 skills**, **29 agents**, **78 commands**, **15 hooks** and **3 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (113): `ab-testing` (Designs A/B tests with statistical methodology, sample sizing, and significance analysis covering hypothesis formulation, variant design, and result…), `adr-format` (ADR(Architecture Decision Record) 작성 스킬), `adversarial-review` (코드를 공격자 관점에서 리뷰하여 취약점, 엣지 케이스, 설계 결함을 탐지), `advertising` (Designs paid advertising campaigns with creative briefs, platform constraints, and bidding strategy optimization for Google Ads, Meta Ads,…), `advisor-strategy` (Claude advisor tool strategy for cost-optimized quality retention), `agent-memory-snapshot` (세션 상태를 압축 스냅샷으로 변환하여 서브에이전트 프롬프트에 주입), `ai-security-standards` (AI/LLM security standards enforcing OWASP LLM Top 10 and Artibot's own threat model), `brand-guidelines` (Manages brand identity including voice guidelines, visual standards, messaging consistency, and brand governance with frameworks for style guides…), and 105 more
- **Agents** (29): `ad-specialist` (Advertising specialist focused on paid media copy, creative briefs, campaign structure, A/B variant generation, and performance optimization across…), `architect` (Systems architecture specialist focused on long-term maintainability, scalability, and structural integrity), `backend-developer` (Backend specialist focused on API design, server-side reliability, and data integrity), `build-error-resolver` (Build and TypeScript error resolution specialist), `code-reviewer` (2단계 코드 리뷰 오케스트레이터), `content-marketer` (Content marketing specialist focused on SEO-optimized writing, social media strategy, email campaigns, and brand voice consistency), `cro-specialist` (Conversion rate optimization specialist focused on landing page audits, funnel analysis, form optimization, A/B test design, and user…), `data-analyst` (Data analysis specialist focused on marketing metrics, statistical analysis, reporting, dashboard design, and data visualization), and 21 more
- **Commands** (78): `ad` ((Artibot) Ad copy creation, creative briefs, campaign structure, and A/B variant generation for paid channels), `adr` ((Artibot) ADR(Architecture Decision Record) 작성 - 두 개 이상 기술 선택지의 trade-off, 숨겨진 비용, 2년 뒤 부채까지 7섹션으로…), `adversarial-review` ((Artibot) Adversarial code review from attacker's perspective using code-reviewer + security-reviewer agents), `analytics` ((Artibot) Marketing analytics dashboards, KPI tracking, performance reports, and attribution analysis), `analyze` ((Artibot) Multi-dimensional code and system analysis with agent delegation), `assemble` ((Artibot) Avengers Assemble), `audit-claude-md` ((Artibot) Audit CLAUDE.md files in the repo, score 6-criteria, propose approved diffs only), `autopilot-queue` ((Artibot) Multi-goal queue & scheduling for autopilot — enqueue goals, run them FIFO, gate by time window, track…), and 70 more
- **Hooks** (15): `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PreCompact`, `Stop`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `SubagentStart`, `SubagentStop`, and 7 more
- **MCP servers** (3): `context7`, `playwright`, `chrome-devtools`

Installs with `claude plugin install artibot@claude-community` from `Yoodaddy0311/artibot` (`plugins/artibot`).
